topic: Beach gear, eskies and your back

slides.headline: Loaded esky, long walk to the sand?
slides.sub: A few ways to get your beach gear there without a grumpy back.

slides.title: Split the load in two
slides.body: One heavy esky in one hand leaves you leaning to the side for the whole walk. Two smaller bags, one in each hand, or a backpack spreads the load and keeps you more upright.

slides.title: Wheels are your friend
slides.body: A beach trolley or an esky with wheels saves a lot of carrying across the car park. On soft sand, pulling it behind you is usually easier than pushing it.

slides.title: Lift the esky like a deadlift
slides.body: Stand close with feet apart, bend at your knees and hips, keep the esky near your body and stand up smoothly. When lifting it from the boot, turn with your feet, not your back.

slides.title: Two trips beat one heroic one
slides.body: Carrying the umbrella, chairs, towels and esky in one go is tempting. Two lighter trips across the sand usually feel easier on your back than one overloaded walk in the heat.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: If back pain after a big beach day spreads down a leg, comes with numbness or weakness, or isn't starting to settle after a few days, it's worth getting it assessed.

slides.headline: Back grumbling after beach days?
slides.body: Our chiropractors look at how you move and lift, then combine hands-on care with simple exercises. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
The beach is the easy part. It's getting the esky there that your back remembers. ☀️

A full esky, umbrella, chairs and a bag of towels can add up to a surprising load, usually carried on one side across a hot car park and soft sand.

A few small changes help: split the load between two hands or a backpack, use wheels wherever you can, lift the esky close to your body with bent knees, and take two lighter trips instead of one big one.

story.headline: Heading to the beach?
story.body: Split the esky load between two hands, use wheels where you can, and take two lighter trips.
